But Area River: But this area is also called a river basin, an area of land drained by a river and all its largeand small tributaries.
River Basins Large: All river basins are large watersheds, butnot all watersheds can be called river basins, some watershedsare very small and their runoff is collected.
Today Attention Focused: Today, attention is being focused on river basins as areas forlarge-scale planning, development, and conservation ofnatural resources.
step_by_step_procedure: Way People Cities: The way people in cities along a river use water and the kinds of wastes they put into the river will affectindustries, businesses, and cities farther.
Remember Care Land: Remember, the care and use of land in your watershed is important to you.
Fires Swept Watersheds: Fires that have swept through watersheds in thewestern United States and have been followed by heavy andprolonged rains have washed huge amounts.
Places Mudslides Carried: In some places, mudslides have carried houses andother buildings with it.

People Animals Plants: People, animals, and plants returnsome through the processof respiration (breathing), and the combustion, orburning, of fuels incars.

step_by_step_procedure: Process Effluent Goes: In one process, the effluent goes from the primary settlingtank to a trickling filter.
There Passes Slowly: There, it passes slowly over stones orother material where biological growths decompose the wasteleft in the effluent.
Stones Material: The stones and other material in the tricklingfilter provide as much surface area as possible with oxygen sothat the biological growths can live.
Effluent Remainsin Sludge: While the effluent remainsin the sludge tank, it is continuously aerated.

pamphlet_excerpts: Conservation Buffers Small: Conservation buffers are small areas or stripsof land kept in permanent vegetation.
Areas Thenhelp Control: These areas thenhelp control soil erosion and pollution by breaking upand slowing the movement of runoff, sediment, andother pollutants within fields.
USDA Launched National: The USDA launched the National Conservation Buffer Initiative in 1997.
Initiative Publicand Private: Through this initiative, publicand private agencies are working together to helplandowners create 2 million miles of conservationbuffers.
step_by_step_procedure: Grassed Contour Buffer: Grassed contour buffer strips cover an entire field in Iowa.
Professional Conservationists: Professional conservationists have solved many conservationproblems.
Practices Suitable: Some practices may be suitable only for application oncroplands, rangelands, or forestlands.
Plants Greatprotectors Land: Because plants are the greatprotectors of land surfaces, most practices involve the use andmanagement of plants so that they can hold soil.
